Within my being, only one salvation remains
The moment I awaken-waken—jet-black wings
My pure heart forever lies, prisoner to the whispering voices
“I’ll save {everyone/humanity}”—in my bosom, this oath stands tall

In a world racing toward its ruin—dance and {sing/be cursed}
This <time/journey> ends in loss... When the door opens—I [withdraw/take form]
At the cost of what I hold most dear, I bestow upon others the gift of dreams・hope

O moon and stars, dance—fleeting fragments of dreams
Even in corruption, remain righteous—melody blooming into malediction
Body and spirit, I surrender—everything
In this moment, my soul ascends to heaven
The voice of God ≈ darkness guides me—
“Marionette” “Dance” “φως” “Awakening” “Celestial” “Inheritance”

Agony/Final/Phantasmagoria/σκιά /Slay/Evil /Cut/
